name: Hell Beetle
body:
This flame-red beetle has gripping pincers and an over-sized maw.

Hell Beetle
CR 3

XP 800
N Small magical beast (extraplanar)
Init +1 Senses blind, limited blindsight 30 ft., scent; Perception +8

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 25 (3d10+9)
Fort +5; Ref +5; Will +2
Immune acid, attack forms which rely on sight, fire

Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee bite +6 (1d6+3 plus 1d4 acid), 2 claws +6 (grab)
Ranged spoor +6 ranged touch (spoor)
Special Attacks grab (Medium), spoor
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +2)

1/minute—summon (level 3, 1d4 hell beetles, 40% -10% per hell beetle currently summoned)

Str 14, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 1, Wis 13, Cha 6
Base Atk +3; CMB +4 (+8 grapple); CMD16 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness
Skills Climb +14, Perception +8

Environment any underground (Hell)
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (3-6)
Treasure incidental

Limited Blindsight (Ex) A hell beetle can perceive creatures and objects it has noticed with its scent ability as if it had blindsight with same range.

Spoor (Su) As a standard action, a hell beetle can squirt pungent fluid at a creature within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. For 1 hour, a target hit with this attack smells faintly of brimstone. For the same duration, any hell beetle summoned within 1 mile of the affected creature is instantly teleported into the open space nearest to the affected creature. If hell beetles are summoned within 1 mile of more than one affected creature, they are teleported towards the nearest affected creature.

Child-sized insects native to Hell, the creatures known as hell beetles are notorious for their ability to summon other of their own kind. A hell beetle encountered without being summoned will mark its prey with a pungent fluid which attracts summoned hell beetles and then retreat. From the safety of a nest only accessible to climbing creatures, the beetle will then summon others of its kind to pursue its marked quarry across distances as great as one mile.

Hell beetles are blind, but have an incredibly keen sense of smell. A typical hell beetle is 3 feet long and weighs upwards of 60 pounds.
